name: Harmonised single-cell and spatial foundation model benchmark (Chen et al. 2026)
description: Harmonised evaluation of six single-cell and spatial foundation models (Nicheformer, CellPLM, scGPT-spatial, GenePT-w, scELMo, Novae) on zero-shot and continually pretrained clustering, supervised cell type annotation, marker-gene concordance and perturbation prediction.

attributes.task: Clustering, cell type annotation and perturbation prediction from foundation model embeddings
attributes.scope_note: No non-foundation-model baseline (for example PCA or scVI) is reported in the result tables.

name: Harmonised benchmarking of foundation models for single-cell and spatial transcriptomics reveals context-dependent generalisation
description: Primary source retrieved and hashed for the 2026-10-11 cells-spatial and networks-mechanistic literature pass.

limitations: Preprint, not peer reviewed.
Single run per cell with a fixed seed (42); no spread is printed.
Spatial dataset codes BC, MH and ME are not defined in the tables; the Figure 2 legend defines them as BC/HBCA1 (human breast cancer), MH/MHPC (mouse hippocampus) and ME/MOSTA E9.5 (mouse embryo).

evidence_concerns.message: Table 4 precision and recall equal accuracy in all eight Nicheformer and CellPLM rows, as micro (global) averaging would give, but recall differs from accuracy in every scGPT-spatial, GenePT-w, scELMo and Novae row.
